title: Telegram-DAO-bot
tagline: Telegram bot that allows you to interact with AirDAO smart contract. This contract is a list of members of "InternetDAO" which is a collective to bargain for better internet deals from service providers.
description:
Collective of people that want to order Internet together cheaply. Potential further development: DAO that wants to stake together, buy energy together, or organic food.

1. Verify proof of human with Worldcoin to talk with the Telegram bot
2. /join <name>, <telegram_username>, <real_life_address>, <AirDAO_testnet_address> - Join the DAO
3. /remove - Remove yourself from the DAO and terminate the contract

You can find the contract on testnet: https://testnet.airdao.io/explorer/address/0x13EAe3662a85b947388284D59b5c49EA66F11c24/

The telegram bot code, logic and Worldcoin Identification on:
https://replit.com/@MiliSkrap/TelegramBotSetup-v2?v=1

The smart contract code at:
https://gist.github.com/Milbaxter/1c50d07beb8e0f3f3932804041ac699f
how_its_made:
- Telegram bot as UX, hosted on Replit
- worldcoin API for verification (via QR code)
- smart contract deployed using airDAO via Ethereum Remix
- The telegram bot controls private key of a developer wallet that does all the edits to the DAO onchain, meaning the users never have to go onchain themselves. The bot does all the work.
